audience: Founders and operators at growing consumer packaged goods brands managing retail, wholesale, ecommerce, distributors, or third-party logistics.
starting_point: A free 30-minute AI Audit conversation for requests that fit the work. Submit the short intake first; Jonathan reviews it and emails next steps. A submission does not automatically reserve a meeting.
audit_focus: Identify a priority bottleneck, the inputs and systems involved, where human approval belongs, and whether a deeper implementation discussion makes sense.
implementation: Workflow diagnosis, scoped implementation around existing systems, and a handoff with clear human owners and exception handling. Scope, timing, and fees are agreed before implementation begins.
boundaries: No forced ERP replacement. An audit does not commit either party to an implementation project. Advisory does not guarantee media coverage or investment.
